description: Pure enrichment module for tool_description_safety signal. Current signal has only 4 distinct values, needs enrichment to improve discrimination. Must expose compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict] returning (score 0-100, evidence dict). Must read MULTIPLE fields from metadata: tool_count, schema_complexity, description_length_avg, has_examples, has_parameter_docs, dangerous_param_indicators. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Should yield at least 20 distinct scores across 34 synthetic fingerprints per enrichment_harness.py contract. Score should reward well-documented tools with clear parameter descriptions and penalize lack of documentation or dangerous parameter patterns. Evidence dict must list fields used and partial scores for auditability.
